description: Opening of a letter to Shemuʾel ha-Dayyan- might be Shemuel b. Saʿadya ha-Levi (1165-1203). The sender states that his purpose is to inform the addressee of the coming (ḥuḍūr) of Yesh[uʿa]. The bottom part is missing. The margins and verso were reused for jottings. AA/ASE
description_he: פתיחת מכתב אל שמואל הדיין – ייתכן שמדובר בשמואל בן סעדיה הלוי (1165–1203). AA
